events.title: Flightline Playable Demo Now LIVE!
events.summary: “Six weeks of playtesting,” Flynn said, looking at the departures board. “How many routes did they stress-test?”“Enough to break three pricing models, push our seat configurations to the limit, and find every detour between New York and London,” Lina replied.“So... are we ready for the crowd?”Lina hit the release key. “Runway is clear. The demo is officially live.”---To every tester who spent the last 6 weeks breaking routes, filing bug reports, and stress-testing our passenger logic: thank you.
